label: water
cmd:
T0=$(date +%s)
  for m in Water_View_RiverLow Water_Perf_RiverLow_Base Water_View_RiverSun Water_Perf_RiverSun_Base Water_Perf_S4 Water_Perf_S4_Base; do
    [ $(( $(date +%s) - T0 )) -gt 720 ] && { echo "perf: out of time before $m"; break; }
    python3 '/Users/midir/sm2-n1/water/tools/perf_ue/run_perf.py' --out '/Users/midir/sm2-n1/_scratch/water/cap/perf_r04/'$m --map /Game/Water/Maps/$m --script none --configs native100 --res 3840x2160 --window 16:31 --timeout 300 --name $m || echo "perf $m failed"
  done
